key_insight: The paper introduces a semi-implicit all-Mach finite-volume method for ILES that remains stable and accurate from high-Mach shocks to low-Mach quasi-incompressible flow.
engineering_relevance: This lets turbulent, compressible, and buoyancy-driven simulations run more efficiently by removing the acoustic CFL time-step restriction while preserving conservation and shock-capturing robustness.
method: Semi-implicit time integration with CFL limited by fluid velocity, not sound speed.
Finite-volume discretization to ensure strict conservation and strong-shock resolution.
Designed for ILES across the full Mach-number spectrum, including gravity-stratified flows.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports validation in both high- and low-Mach regimes, plus stratified atmospheres, with favorable comparison to published multimode Richtmyer-Meshkov ILES results from the Θ-group collaboration.
watch_item: Performance and accuracy depend on careful implementation of the semi-implicit solver to maintain stability across strong shocks, gravity, and very low-Mach conditions.
paper_title: A Semi-Implicit All-Mach Numerical Method for Implicit Large Eddy Simulations
